decisions.reason: Dampsoft publicly announced the digital anamnesis and consent app as 'the new product line', gave it its own page, and tied it to its digitalization strategy for dental practices, so the high investment and visible commitment make keeping and further developing it the likely course.

The continuing education institute supports the firm's core practice-software customer relationships and needs little investment, so management will keep it and attribute any weak early uptake to start-up effects.
The remote screen-sharing support tool is a low-cost service component built into the firm's customer support for its practice software, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
